params.val: reflects the incoming status move back at whoever used it

the incoming move is not a status move, or is flagged as unreflectable, OR the move has already been bounced once (no infinite bounce loops), OR the holder is currently semi-invulnerable (Fly/Dig/Dive/etc.)
the same effect as the Magic Coat status, but always active rather than needing to be set up each turn

ADDED two missing exclusions -- verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (magicbounce): hasBounced prevents a move from being reflected twice, and isSemiInvulnerable() skips bouncing while the holder is mid-Fly/Dig/etc. Also has a separate onAllyTryHitSide hook: in doubles/multis, a Magic Bounce holder can bounce a status move aimed at its ally's side back at the attacker even if the move wasn't targeting the holder directly.
